facts.claim: Berlin's Übernachtungsteuer (City Tax) is 7.5% of the net price of the overnight stay, excluding VAT and extras such as breakfast; the rate rose to 7.5% on 1 January 2025.

facts.claim: The City Tax is levied on the amount paid for the overnight stay (per room price), not per person; the law (ÜnStG §4-5) sets the base as the price for the stay without VAT and other services, and the rate at 7.5%.

sources.title: Berlin Senate Department for Finance: FAQ Übernachtungsteuer (City Tax)
Übernachtungsteuergesetz Berlin, version valid from 1 January 2026 (text published by DEHOGA Berlin)

The tax follows the room price, so two people sharing a room pay the same as one

facts.claim: German VAT on short-term accommodation is the reduced 7% rate (UStG §12(2) no. 11); services not directly part of the room, such as breakfast, fall under the standard 19% rate (§12(1)).
